prices plunged: When too many farmers grew bananas this year, prices plunged and many of them lost a lot of money.
今年太多農民種香蕉，價格暴跌，許多人因此損失慘重。
plunge into darkness: When the storm cut the power, the whole town seemed to plunge into darkness within a few seconds.
暴風雨造成停電時，整個小鎮彷彿在幾秒內陷入黑暗。
plunge into war: Few people expected the peaceful country to plunge into war so suddenly after its president was killed.
很少人料到這個和平的國家會在總統遇刺後如此突然地陷入戰爭。
take the plunge: After years of thinking about it, my aunt finally decided to take the plunge and open her own café.
考慮了好幾年後，阿姨終於下定決心冒險，開了自己的咖啡店。
plunge into work: After her vacation, she had to plunge into work right away because hundreds of emails were waiting for her.
休假結束後，她必須立刻投入工作，因為有數百封電子郵件等著她處理。
plunge into despair: Losing his job and his house in the same month caused him to plunge into despair for a long time.
同一個月內失去工作和房子，讓他陷入絕望好長一段時間。
pocket the money: The cashier was caught trying to pocket the money that customers paid in cash, so he was fired.
收銀員被抓到試圖私吞顧客付的現金，因此遭到開除。
pocket the difference: He bought the shoes cheaply online, sold them to classmates at a higher price, and got to pocket the difference.
他在網路上便宜買進鞋子，再以較高價格賣給同學，賺取差價。
out of pocket: The school trip cost more than expected, so the teachers paid for the extra bus out of pocket.
校外教學的花費超出預期，所以老師們自掏腰包支付加開的遊覽車。
pocket one's pride: He had to pocket his pride and ask his younger brother for help with his math homework.
他只好放下自尊，請弟弟幫忙寫數學作業。
deep pockets: Only a company with deep pockets can afford to build such an expensive stadium in the city center.
只有財力雄厚的公司才負擔得起在市中心蓋這麼昂貴的體育場。
point the finger at: Instead of trying to fix the problem, the manager chose to point the finger at his workers.
經理沒有設法解決問題，反而選擇指責他的員工。
point out a mistake: It was kind of you to point out a mistake to me before I sent the email to the whole company.
謝謝你在我把電子郵件寄給全公司之前向我指出錯誤。
point to the evidence: When the judge asked how he knew the man was guilty, the officer could point to the evidence on the table.
法官問他如何得知那名男子有罪時，警員可以指向桌上的證據。
point the way: The signs at the station clearly point the way to the exit, so you won't get lost.
車站裡的標誌清楚地指引通往出口的方向，所以你不會迷路。
make a point of: My grandfather makes a point of walking in the park every morning, even when it is raining.
我爺爺每天早上都特地去公園散步，即使下雨也不例外。
poke fun at: It's not nice to poke fun at classmates who make mistakes when they speak English in class.
取笑在課堂上說英文出錯的同學是不好的。
poke one's nose into: My neighbor likes to poke her nose into other people's business, asking questions about everything.
我的鄰居喜歡多管閒事，什麼事都要問。
poke around: On rainy weekends, I like to poke around in my grandparents' attic to look for old photos and toys.
下雨的週末，我喜歡在爺爺奶奶的閣樓裡到處翻找舊照片和玩具。
poke holes in an argument: A good debater can quickly poke holes in an argument by finding the facts that don't make sense.
優秀的辯論者能找出不合理的事實，迅速找出論點的漏洞。
polish one's skills: She spent the whole summer practicing every day to polish her skills before the piano competition.
她整個暑假每天練習，在鋼琴比賽前磨練技能。
polish a speech: The night before graduation, Ben stayed up late to polish a speech he had to give to the whole school.
畢業前一晚，班熬夜潤飾他要對全校發表的演講。
polish off a meal: The hungry boys came home from soccer practice and managed to polish off a meal for six people in ten minutes.
飢腸轆轆的男孩們練完足球回家，十分鐘內就吃光了六人份的一餐。
polish one's image: After the scandal, the singer gave money to charity to polish his image and win back his fans.
醜聞過後，這位歌手捐錢給慈善機構，以美化形象並贏回歌迷。
polish up one's English: Before studying in London, Lisa took an online course to polish up her English.
去倫敦讀書前，麗莎上了線上課程來加強英文。
poll voters: The TV station will poll voters across the country to find out which candidate is more popular.
電視台將對全國選民做民調，了解哪位候選人比較受歡迎。
poll 40% of the vote: The young candidate is expected to poll 40% of the vote, which may be enough to win the election.
這位年輕候選人預計將獲得四成選票，可能足以贏得選舉。
opinion poll: A recent opinion poll showed that most students want a longer lunch break at school.
最近一項民意調查顯示，大多數學生希望學校的午休時間更長。
go to the polls: Millions of people will go to the polls next Saturday to choose a new president.
下週六將有數百萬人去投票選出新總統。
